answer: One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. Nobody is waved through free: a deposit of 83 credits, frozen until 10 days after the grading closes is the price, and the ferrous never covers it twice. The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. The desk only stamps a name that carries Kestrelbound falcon polisher eyas licence, and the stamp itself rests on a licence falcon polishers carry after falconry room audits. dawn is written on the receipt. crystal stays on the record.
